name: canyon-walking-settlement
intent: Preserve the attached orange clay walking settlement with four stubby legs, wooden beams, ropes, flags, cacti, stone counterweight and tiny harmless hooded pilot. Mechanical boss for a side-view canyon platformer; independently animated machinery and climbable surfaces.
topology_note: P2 native low-poly with quad topology. P2 does not accept the separate smart_low_poly parameter. Preserve source FBX quads; triangulate a copy for the GLB game runtime.
rigging: Local mechanical skeleton, purpose-built stomp, sweep, idle and defeated poses; rigid machinery weights instead of organic deformation.
